methodology: Security Monitoring via Scoped-Capability MCP (read-only, unprivileged)

steps.detail: firewall_status/listening_ports/net_connections/process_top — nothing can be mutated through them
runs as a non-login user with ONLY CAP_NET_ADMIN+CAP_NET_RAW (ambient+bounding) — never root; nftables inspection needs exactly these
Restart=always; the process supervisor tracks auto_start opt-ins
tools sharing one (transport,endpoint) flip together — one toggle, no half-on desync
a firewall_status call must return the actual ruleset; an 'Operation not permitted' means caps are missing, not that the tool is broken
